question: Are there any good restaurants in Colachel?
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = sd.subcategory_id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sd.status = 1 AND sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city = 'Colachel' AND sc.subcategoryname = 'Restaurent' GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;
